description_policy: Written for RETRIEVAL, not marketing. Each says what the tool does in the nouns and verbs a caller would use mid-task, names the concrete things it returns, and avoids the tool's own brand vocabulary. Description quality is the ceiling on every number Phase 0 produces, so each was written after calling the API and reading its real response.
selection_policy: Chosen as what a general agent toolkit would plausibly wrap: well-known, free, no-auth public APIs across unrelated domains. Deliberately NOT chosen by reading eval/queries.json — selecting tools to match the frozen queries would contaminate the measurement from the other direction. Whether a given query turns out answerable is therefore an outcome.
excluded: dictionaryapi.dev — connection failure, no response at all
restcountries.com — returns HTTP 200 with a deprecation error body on v3.1 and v5 alike

tools.name: Weather Forecast
tools.description: Hourly and daily weather forecast for a latitude and longitude: temperature, precipitation, wind speed and cloud cover, from now up to 16 days ahead. Answers what conditions will be like at a place on a given day, including whether it will rain.

tools.name: Address to Coordinates
tools.description: Turn a written place name or street address into latitude and longitude. Accepts partial and informal input such as a city, a landmark or a postal address, and returns the best matching coordinates with a normalised display name.

input.query: string, an address or place name

tools.name: Coordinates to Address
tools.description: Turn a latitude and longitude into a human readable address: street, neighbourhood, city, region, postcode and country. Answers where a given point actually is.

tools.name: Currency Converter
tools.description: Convert an amount of money from one currency into another at current or historical exchange rates. Covers major and many minor currencies and can answer what a sum was worth on a specific past date.

tools.name: Encyclopedia Summary
tools.description: Short factual background on a person, place, organisation, event or concept, drawn from an encyclopedia article. Returns a plain prose summary plus the article title and link, for getting oriented on an unfamiliar subject.

input.title: string, the subject or article title

tools.name: Public Holidays
tools.description: Official public holidays for a country in a given year, with the date, local name and English name of each. Useful for working out whether offices will be closed, or which days in a period are non working.

tools.name: Sunrise and Sunset Times
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, dawn, dusk and day length for a latitude and longitude on a given date. Answers how much daylight there is and when it starts and ends at a place.

tools.name: Ground Elevation
tools.description: Height above sea level in metres for a latitude and longitude. Answers how high above sea level a point is, for terrain, flooding and route questions.

tools.name: Postal Code Lookup
tools.description: Which town, state and coordinates a postal or ZIP code refers to. Works the other way from an address lookup: give the code, get the places it covers, for validating or expanding an address.

tools.name: Academic Paper Search
tools.description: Search published scholarly literature by topic, title or author and get back titles, authors, journal, publication date and DOI. Covers peer reviewed journal articles, conference papers and preprints across every field.

input.query: string, a research topic or title

tools.name: Book Lookup by ISBN
tools.description: Bibliographic details for a book from its ISBN: title, authors, publisher, publication date and page count. For identifying or citing a physical book you have the barcode or number for.

tools.name: Source Repository Facts
tools.description: Facts about a public code repository: description, primary language, open source licence, star and fork counts, open issue count and last push date. For checking what a project is and whether it is maintained before depending on it.

tools.name: Cryptocurrency Spot Price
tools.description: Current market price of a cryptocurrency quoted in a conventional currency such as dollars, euros or pounds. Returns the live spot rate for coins and tokens by name.

tools.name: Country Development Indicator
tools.description: Official national statistics for a country over time: population, GDP, life expectancy, literacy, electricity access and hundreds of other development indicators, each as a dated series of values.

tools.name: Current Local Time
tools.description: What time it is right now in a named timezone, with the date, day of week and UTC offset. For working out whether it is business hours somewhere, or converting a meeting time between places.

tools.name: QR Code Generator
tools.description: Produce a scannable QR code image encoding a link, plain text, phone number or contact details, at a chosen pixel size. Returns a PNG image rather than JSON.

tools.name: Caller Public IP
tools.description: The public internet address the request appears to come from. For confirming which egress address a machine is using, or what a remote service will see as the source.

tools.name: Recent Earthquakes
tools.description: Seismic events recorded worldwide, filtered by magnitude and recency, each with magnitude, depth, time and a named location. For checking whether a quake has just happened somewhere and how strong it was.

tools.name: Packaged Food Nutrition
tools.description: Nutrition facts for a packaged grocery item looked up by its barcode: energy, fat, sugar, salt, protein and ingredients as printed on the label. For reading what is actually in a supermarket product.
